d: Market Research Analyst: New Consumer App (Kuwait)

We are building a new consumer mobile app for the Kuwaiti market, in the lifestyle space. We are looking for a Market Research Analyst to help us understand the market, the customers and the competition before and after launch.
q: 2+ years in market research, consumer insights or business analysis.
Strong Excel skills; able to clean data and present clear numbers with sources.
Experience designing surveys and interviewing customers.
Based in Kuwait; fluent Arabic and English.
Experience with consumer apps, F&B, retail, entertainment or lifestyle in Kuwait.
Tools such as Google Forms/Typeform, Power BI or similar.
r: Run market studies: market size, customer segments, trends and competitors in Kuwait.
Design and run customer surveys, interviews and field research, and turn them into clear findings.
Track competitors' offers, prices and positioning, and report changes.
Build simple, reliable reports and dashboards (Excel) with clear sources.
Support pricing and go-to-market decisions with data.
x: Shape key decisions of a new product from the start, working directly with the founder.
How to apply: Please apply with your full, updated CV attached. Applications without a CV will not be considered.
